notes: Validated against Montange & Batey Nature 2006 (doi:10.1038/nature04440) and Stoddard et al. Structure 2010. SAM is recognised through three chemically distinct moieties: (1) Adenosine: base triple A45-U57-SAM adenine; sheared A46-U78 pair recognises the Watson-Crick and Hoogsteen faces. (2) Methionine main chain: contacts G11-(C44-G58) triple; carboxylate H-bonds G11 N1/N2 Watson-Crick face. (3) Sulfonium cation: electrostatic interaction with U7 and U88 carbonyl O2/O4 in the P1 helix minor groove. MacVina calibration does not list phosphateElectrostatic as an expected term for this prepared PDBQT because the local reference geometry places the methionine-tail sulfonium/amine atoms outside the phosphate cutoff from A61/A62, and the cited sulfonium contact is to base carbonyl oxygens rather than backbone phosphate atoms. The ligandAtoms list only adenine-ring atoms capable of baseStacking; methionine-tail atoms (SD, CE, CG, CB, CA, N, C, O, OXT) are non-aromatic and cannot produce baseStacking. C:47 replaced A:47 in receptorResidues (PDB residue 47 is a cytidine, not adenosine). 2026-06-03: removed non-aromatic ligand atoms (S, C_carboxylate, O1, O2) that cannot produce baseStacking; replaced with PDBQT-correct adenine ring atom names.
